blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Base block 52110793 independently confirms hasRole(BLOCKLIST_ROLE,0x2c34489fd3b7cc2a5dc4a47b34b117d3f62b6e9e)=true and paused()=false. Coinbase technical reference states transfer/transferFrom fail for blocklisted accounts or global pause; role/event census corroborates the exact implementation's local restrictions. April 7 Cantina report reviews EVM Stablecoin, MutableBeaconProxy, Blocklist and RateLimit; this is code-security evidence, not financial assurance. August 2026 Cantina report covers Solana mint-controller only and does not support this Base deployment.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The reviewed native ONED liability exists only on Base. Coinbase identifies the exact Base token; native holder terms explicitly exclude redemption of copies, wrapped tokens and bridged versions. No additional representation is authored.
